# EZcods IT Solutions

> EZcods IT Solutions is an Indian software development company. We build
> business websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps and custom CRM / ERP
> software for businesses of every size.

## Services

- Business websites: informational and animated/premium sites, built with React and Next.js.
- E-commerce development: custom online stores, payment gateway integration, order management.
- Mobile apps: Android and iOS apps with Flutter and React Native.
- Custom CRM / ERP: lead management, inventory, billing and accounting software built around how a business works.
- Desktop / offline software: Electron, .NET (WinForms, WPF) and Python desktop apps.
